text: Schedule. My schedule changes every semester.
Commute. My commute is short. I walk.
Campus. I live two blocks from campus.
Deadline. The deadline is Friday at midnight.
Break. We take a break between classes.
Focus. I focus better in the morning.
Manage. I manage my week with a calendar.
Attend. I attend classes four days a week.
My schedule this semester is terrible. I attend classes five days a week.
Five? I only go three days. But my commute is an hour and ten minutes.
Each way?
Each way. I always leave home at six. I never focus in the first class.
Okay, you win. I live ten minutes from campus.
So how do you manage five days?
I do not, honestly. I have three deadlines next week and I usually start the night before.
My sister does that too. She always says never again, and she always does it again.
Your sister and I would get along.
That is what worries me. See you Thursday.
I attend classes four days a week.
My commute is short. I usually walk.
I focus better in the morning.
I have three deadlines this week.
We go to the beach twice a month.

You asked about my Tuesday, so here it is, and it is not exciting. I wake up at half past six and I leave home at twenty past seven, because the first class starts at eight and I hate arriving late. Classes until midday. Then I usually eat something on campus with the same two people, always the same table. In the afternoon I have a group project, and on Tuesday I never go to the gym. I go three times a week, but never on Tuesday, because by six o clock I am finished. What does a normal Tuesday look like for you?

Good morning, everyone. A quick note about the schedule. Starting next week, the statistics class moves from Thursday to Wednesday at eight in the morning. I know. Eight. It is not my decision. The room changes as well: it is room four zero two, same building, one floor up. And because the class moves, the deadline for the second assignment moves too, one week later, to the twenty-ninth. Please update your calendars today, not the night before. Thank you.
